actual.classification_reason: Flag: FLAM=C → flag_type=REAL_FAIL. Hazard applies in GH2: False. Classification: ANTI_RULE. Automatable — tool can generate Form 551.
actual.rationale: INCONEL 625 (MAPTIS 10727) carries a promoted ignition rating of C, indicating test specimens exhibited a burn length greater than 6.0 inches under standard promoted combustion conditions in oxygen-enriched environments per NHB 8060.1C. This rating is not applicable to the actual service environment. The material operates exclusively in GH2 media with no oxygen-enriched atmosphere. The failure mode underlying the C rating — promoted ignition and sustained combustion propagation in enriched oxygen — is not credible in a GH2 fluid system. The flammability screening requirement per NASA-STD-6016C §4.2.1.1 [MPR 44] is satisfied because the hazard condition does not exist at the point of use. GH2 compatibility is addressed under H2COMPAT companion MUA per NASA-STD-6016C §4.2.6.4 [MPR 192/193] and §4.2.1.3 [MPR 47] (TBD).
actual.disposition: Accepted. The screening failure does not constitute a hazard in this application. Material operates in GH2 with no conditions that would activate the failure mode. No additional testing or controls required for this screening deficiency.
